line.comment: * When installing the signature Disruptor, we enable the Pirate Cover State.
* This allows the ship to appear as a Pirate to other nations, which allows it to travel through Pirate infested space unmollested, and
* often through other common wealth nation space without being targeted, regardless of War State.
* Add-Ons 1.12.4: Blacklist wares here depending on conditions. (1.13.2: Made a mistake - smaller ships can stil get hacked. AFS is no longer blacklisted.)
* 1. Ware is a carrier repair module and the ship doesn't have docking bays.

sval.val: When installing the signature Disruptor, we enable the Pirate Cover State.
